verdicts.reason: A: the Meridian logo straddles the card's top edge. The 'See Fares' CTA is shrunk to an illegible pill buried at the bottom of a mostly empty card, and the card bleeds off the right edge, so the hierarchy is broken. B: the logo has been pulled out of the card onto the dune image and clips the card's left edge, and the card also bleeds off the right with a large dead gap under the headline. Even so, the headline, subtitle and CTA are legible and the CTA stays prominent, so B is the less bad resize.
